Setup (all runs): multi-core host, Docker, JDK 21 Temurin, Preview via
`preview-node.play.dev.cardano.org:3001`. The node container had `--cpus 4` unless stated;
`-Xmx6g` before and `-Xmx3g` after the changes below. Profiles are JFR (`settings=profile`) taken
from the running node and aggregated over `jdk.ExecutionSample`; JFR samples a few threads per
interval, so shares below are shares of samples.

[Current and legacy-derived maintained V5 snapshot results](https://github.com/KD5UJC-XYZ/scarab/blob/bacac5342d5d09d37e2a949e9f23a2312cce560a/docs/performance.md#32-typed-snapshot-codec-derivation-205); identical complete bytes/typed state/truncation refusals

Encode/decode improve 7.44–17.26%; worst candidate JVM median against fastest baseline ≤+2.63%. Primary limit passes. Tiny two-field encode +17.72%, about 6.1 ns/call, tracked in #257; no universal speed-up claim.

Conditional-given regressions fail against the old dispatcher (100 constructions instead of 1) and enum-only retention (201 instead of 2); mixed singleton/data enum selection is corrected. Six old/typed/candidate model runs have identical full fingerprints; largest primary time median increase against original is 6.8%.

[Fresh dev-based evidence at `ca22fad2`](https://github.com/KD5UJC-XYZ/scarab/blob/ca22fad29b8b41f7d47a94b3968a060f1b0a13e5/docs/compatibility.md#evidence-log): check passes 5,146 tests; 1,699 applications and 64/64 ledger comparisons match, with 38 rollbacks/7 reconnects retained. Equal-state allocation remains 3.3–17.6% above original. Generic/phantom proof through `productElement`/`ClassTag` remains a bounded obligation in #206; no claim that runtime checks establish it.

[Typed interning source and independent representative decode/heap comparison](https://github.com/KD5UJC-XYZ/scarab/blob/2f7983d716919001f67a3ff0061998311200eaa2/docs/performance.md#33-typed-per-kind-decode-interning-204); complete state/refusal fingerprints and retained object counts match.

Current/legacy-derived decode aggregates −7.11%/+2.92%, adverse cross-JVM median comparisons +2.70%/+8.54%; allocation +0.03%/+0.31%; retained heap at most +0.32%. Both primary inputs pass 10%; snapshot restart and full check pass. Extended-fuzz/exact-head receipts are on #263.

Each declared field/variant must use its own codec in original order. #247 replaces these with typed derivation and generated accessors; its bytes, errors and migrations are measured/tested. Cast-free source alone would not establish this.

A kind and decode must select only `Table[A]`, with first-instance identity and bounded lifetime. #204 is the typed implementation/measurement track; values cannot be recovered through an erased registry.

`productElement` returns erased values; `ClassTag` does not validate generic arguments or phantom roles. #260 repairs retention and enum selection, while #206 retains the bounded obligation to generate typed accessors/variant operations and add positive/negative generic-role probes. No `Diff[Any]` source is necessary for this gap to exist.

Cached comparator must belong to exactly `K`, preserving comparator identity and linear sorted-map copying. #255 tracks a typed recovery design; moving the check or replacing it with a runtime key class test is insufficient.

Bounded rendering only: 64 nodes/512 characters, complete typed error payload retained, no generic value returned to a typed operation. #261 bounds a typed AST diagnostic walker; no observed ledger/model defect is claimed.
The certified parameter is neither recovered nor consumed on the UTXOS path; this is safe widening, with no corresponding erased-value retrieval operation to repair.
